mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, we are looking at clear skies near the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 34 degrees and a waning crescent moon visible overhead.

The City of Verona has several items on the agenda for the December 7th Plan Commission meeting, notably the site plan and conditional use permit for the Sub-Zero project in Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Public Works Department continues its mission of maintaining city infrastructure and reminds residents they can sign up for the digital city newsletter to track ongoing projects.

There is a great lineup of local entertainment this week. Catch live music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market in Madison or catch live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking further ahead, join the fun with trivia nights on November 11th at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call for service on October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I, first offence.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM. Stop by to enjoy today's featured flavor, which is the rich and decadent Chocolate Volcano.
